how: Walls are the dark lines of the plan image; rooms are the spaces they enclose, with door gaps closed by extending each wall end up to 2 m. The plan was fitted to the ground with a similarity transform on 5 control points (1501ST over floor 2 501ST; 1500EL over floor 2 500EL; 1500ST over floor 2 500ST; 1700EL over floor 2 700EL; 1700ST over floor 2 700ST).
notes: Room numbers are read from the plan's label boxes. Suffixes: CO and CU are corridors, ST stairs, EL elevators (UCLA Space Inventory codes).
